name: Carimbo
description: Practical travel guides to Brazil and five of the world's most visited countries: where to go, when to go and what to sort out before you book.

author.name: [Your Name]
author.shortBio: [One or two sentences about you, e.g. where in Southeast Brazil you live and the trips you plan or have taken.]

sections.name: Brazil
sections.intro: Beaches, rainforest, waterfalls and some of the liveliest cities in South America. Our home country, and the place we know best.

sections.name: United States
sections.intro: National parks, road trips and big cities, in a country so large that most visitors only see a corner of it.

sections.name: Spain
sections.intro: Moorish palaces, late dinners and a coastline that runs from the Basque Country to Andalusia.

sections.name: England
sections.intro: London, cathedral cities, national parks and villages that look exactly like the postcards.

sections.name: France
sections.intro: The most visited country in the world, and far more than Paris: castles, coast, Alps and vineyards.

sections.name: Italy
sections.intro: Ancient Rome, Renaissance Florence, the canals of Venice and a coast built into the cliffs.
